contracts.relationship_memory: Existing typed live state supplies the guard; the 12-message contact history remains bounded and is not relationship authority.
contracts.caller_order: Speech-start/committed item IDs establish bounded turn ownership; an earlier first final may supply a relationship only when newer explicit evidence has not superseded it.
contracts.duplicate_and_revision: Exact duplicates and stale revisions cannot advance current state. A changed current final replaces only relationship contribution against a saved prior baseline; unrelated tool/contact/delivery facts remain.
contracts.action_revision: Changed current final increments the independent action-admission token. The action executor freezes it before async policy reads and checks it before claim and external effect.
contracts.opt_out: Provider-final caller DNC passes the existing assertion filter before order admission; opt-out remains monotonic while old text cannot hang up a newer question.
contracts.bounded_state: At most64 provider item metadata/digests, one pre-current relationship baseline, existing12-message contact buffer. Valid supplied audio offsets use a session-relative floor; malformed/negative/nonfinite offsets are rejected.
contracts.transcript_evidence: One latest ASR revision is attached to the matching original user row, preserving original speech/timestamp and othermetadata. Revision content capped4096characters with full digest/count and truncation/retraction flags; sealed calls cannot be revived.
contracts.late_relationship_playout: Accepted relationship evidence revalidates unfinished audio before first and subsequent transport submissions. Local utterance identity/status is rechecked after gateway awaits; swallowed cancellation cannot authorize later chunks, late completed receipts or contact confirmation. Completed historical utterances stay historical.
contracts.late_relationship_continuation: Cancellation retains interrupted/unknown partial-delivery evidence and uses receipt-based truncation. After publishing current state, one ordinary request_response continuation shares the existing repair budget. It never uses withheld/not-heard repair for an utterance that may have been submitted.

limitations: Canonical transcript JSON/plaintext and downstream Lead extraction do not yet apply the latest-ASR-revision metadata. This is an explicit AG05 handoff, not a completed transcript-correction feature.
An initial empty transcription has no original text row under the existing TranscriptService contract; canonical handling of such retractions/revisions remains AG05.

Metadata-poor providers rely on the existing single ordered, non-replayed websocket connection. Unknown assistant previous_item_id is not rejected. There is no reconnect/resume or unbounded replay ledger.
Pure caller assertion matching is deliberately conservative; these tests do not certify all language or qualitative model claims.
No live OpenAI/xAI session, PSTN call, production mutation or default-model change was performed. xAI remains hidden/opt-in with existing availability limitations.
Traditional accepted-dispatch ordering and the authoritative combined validation are owned by the parent/shared-state agent; native-only counts do not certify that later source delta.
Transport submission cannot prove human hearing; already-emitted audio cannot be undone. Tests use synthetic PCM and fake gateway receipts, not acoustic or real call validation.

primary_sources.used_for: Final transcription completions can arrive out of speech order; item identity is needed for reconciliation.
Generated official GA schema defines audio_start_ms against all input audio in the session, including prefix padding.
Provider documents shared Realtime event compatibility and cumulative transcription updates; no new model or resumption feature was adopted.
